title: Learning an Anchored Prompt Space for Continual Adaptation of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.32499v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Continually adapting large language models requires acquiring new knowledge while preserving previously learned capabilities. Although jointly adapting model parameters and task-specific soft prompts is promising, it has two key limitations: previously learned prompts may lose effectiveness as the model evolves, and relationships among prompts that could support cross-task transfer are not explicitly learned. We propose Learning an Anchored Prompt Space (LAPS), which preserves historical prompt effectiveness and learns relationships among task-specific soft prompts to facilitate positive transfer. Historical prompts are first aligned with the updated model through self-distillation. LAPS then constructs an anchored prompt space whose vertices correspond to learned task-specific soft prompts and whose intermediate geometry is shaped by learnable B\'ezier control prompts. translated_title: 学习锚定提示空间以实现大语言模型的持续适配
translated_abstract: 持续适配大语言模型需要在获取新知识的同时保留先前学习到的能力。尽管联合适配模型参数和任务特定的软提示是一种有前景的方法，但它存在两个关键局限性：先前学习的提示可能随着模型的演进而失去有效性，并且支持跨任务迁移的提示之间的关系没有被显式学习。我们提出了学习锚定提示空间（LAPS），该方法保留历史提示的有效性，并学习任务特定软提示之间的关系以促进正向迁移。历史提示首先通过自蒸馏与更新后的模型对齐。随后，LAPS构建一个锚定提示空间，其顶点对应于已学习的任务特定软提示，其中间几何结构由可学习的贝塞尔控制提示塑造。一旦学习了这个空间，LAPS即可识别最佳表现……
tldr: 提出LAPS方法，通过自蒸馏对齐历史提示，并构建以任务特定软提示为顶点、贝塞尔控制提示塑造几何结构的锚定提示空间，从而在持续适配大语言模型时保留提示有效性并促进跨任务正向迁移。
en_tdlr: LAPS preserves historical prompt effectiveness through self-distillation and constructs an anchored prompt space with task-specific soft prompts as vertices and learnable Bézier control prompts shaping its geometry, enabling continual adaptation of large language models with cross-task positive transfer.
